title: Physics of Climate
description: Examines the physics that determines Earth's climate and controls how climate changes. May include study of Earth’s atmosphere, ocean and cryosphere, and comparison to other Earth-like planets. Analyses climate data and examines a hierarchy of climate models, from idealised mathematical models to complex Global Climate Models.
notes: Credit will be granted for only one of PHYS 433, EOS 433.
May be offered as a joint undergraduate and graduate class.
Normally offered in alternate years; consult with the School of Earth and Ocean Sciences to determine schedule.
